title: Weather and Seasons

story.title: Four seasons in Tashkent
story.text: I’m Laylo from Tashkent. We have four very different **seasons** here. **Summer** is very **hot** – sometimes the **temperature** is 42 **degrees**! It’s **sunny** every day and it almost never rains. People **stay indoors** in the afternoon. | **Autumn** is my favourite season. It’s **warm** in September and **cool** in November. There are lots of fruits. Sometimes it’s **cloudy** and **windy**. | **Winter** can be **cold**, but it isn’t **freezing** every day. Sometimes it’s **snowy**. It **gets dark** very early – at five o’clock! In the mornings it’s often **foggy**. | In **spring** everything is green, and it’s often **rainy**, so I always take an **umbrella**. Sometimes there is a big **storm**. Before I leave home, I always check the **weather forecast** on my phone. I think our **climate** is great – you can enjoy every season!

answers: What is your favourite season? Why?
**My favourite season is** spring **because** everything is green and **it’s** not too hot. **For example**, in April we have picnics in the mountains with my family.
Does the weather change your mood?
Yes, it does. **When it’s** sunny, I feel happy and active. **I can’t stand** rainy, grey **weather** – it makes me sleepy and a bit sad.
speech: Hi everyone! Let’s talk about the weather. **In my country, summers are** very hot **and winters are** cold. **My favourite season is** autumn **because** it’s warm and there are delicious fruits everywhere – grapes, melons and pomegranates. **I can’t stand** very hot **weather**. **When it’s** forty degrees, I just **like to** stay at home with the air conditioner! I don’t mind snow – it’s beautiful. I always check the weather forecast in the morning. Today **it’s quite** cloudy and cool. **It looks like rain**, so I have my umbrella! Thank you!
